candidates.name: cache-references
candidates.meaning: Kernel generic cache references; cache level, prefetch and request scope are CPU/kernel dependent.

candidates.name: l2_request_g1.rd_blk_l
candidates.meaning: L2 data-cache read requests including hardware/software prefetch; NOT generic LLC references.

candidates.name: cache-misses
candidates.meaning: Kernel generic cache misses; not guaranteed to be demand-load or LLC misses.

candidates.name: l2_cache_req_stat.ls_rd_blk_c
candidates.meaning: Core-to-L2 data request misses excluding L2 prefetch; NOT retired-load/LLC misses.

candidates.name: L1-dcache-loads
candidates.meaning: Kernel L1D read-access mapping; speculative versus retired scope must be checked per CPU.

candidates.name: ls_dispatch.ld_dispatch
candidates.meaning: Dispatched load operations including speculation; not retired loads.

candidates.name: L1-dcache-load-misses
candidates.meaning: Kernel L1D read-miss mapping; may count refills rather than retired misses.

candidates.name: ls_mab_alloc.loads
candidates.meaning: Load miss-address-buffer allocations; previously failed to track L1 capacity on Skylark.

candidates.name: L1-dcache-stores
candidates.meaning: Kernel L1D write-access mapping; the read-only kernel should have little store activity.

candidates.name: ls_refills_from_sys.ls_mabresp_lcl_l2
candidates.meaning: Demand data fills from local L2; refill/replacement evidence, NOT stores.

candidates.name: LLC-loads
candidates.meaning: Kernel last-level read-access mapping; do not assume identical LLC domains across CPUs.

candidates.name: ls_refills_from_sys.ls_mabresp_lcl_cache
candidates.meaning: Demand fills from local cache domain excluding local L2; not total LLC accesses or pure LLC hits.

candidates.name: LLC-load-misses
candidates.meaning: Kernel last-level read-miss mapping; interpretation depends on CPU and firmware.

candidates.name: ls_refills_from_sys.ls_mabresp_lcl_dram
candidates.meaning: Demand fills from DRAM or IO on this die; omits remote DRAM and is NOT direct LLC misses.

candidates.name: dTLB-load-misses
candidates.meaning: Kernel data-TLB read-miss mapping; may mean page walks rather than L1 TLB misses.

candidates.name: ls_l1_d_tlb_miss.all
candidates.meaning: All L1 data TLB misses/reloads, not just page walks.
